lines.en: Your costume. I don't get it.
Oh, well, I mean, does it--
This doesn't smell like hand sanitizer.
Yeah, I didn't have any, so I used Dijon Ace.
Look, I made a spoon hat.
Well, that explains why I'm having to eat my soup with a fork.
You've been bumming around ever since you got home from school.
- Don't worry about it. - Come on, talk to me.
Nothing stupid to a guy in a spoon hat.
Sam and Freddie have been making fun of me
- I knew you'd laugh. - I'm not laughing.
Sometimes my lip just quivers like this.
You just better take that off before Sam sees you in it.
My mom made it for me
and I promised her I'd wear it tonight while we do iCarly.
Hey, I gotta take this letter down to the lobby.
OK, so do you want to take the stairs
or do you want to fly us there on your broom?
I'm sorry. Don't get mad and turn me into a toad.
What in the blazes are you doing?
Dang it! I already told you a billion times.
Will you tell this it's a sight in a squirrel?
Hey, hey, look who's back from the dance!
This is a Crazy Hat Spaghetti Taco Party!
Colonel Shay, it's an honor to meet you.
I'm T-Bow, friend of Carly and Spencer's.
T-Bow lives across the hall with Freddie and his mother.
Oh, so are you dating Freddie's mother?
I hear you sell movies here. Cheap. Is that true or what?
- So you do sell movies? - Sure.
I guess the word's getting around, huh?
Yeah, the word that you sell pirated movies, right?
No, no, no. I sell pirate movies.
I make them... I make them myself with my buddies.
This is the first one we ever made.
Oh, we made this one last year.
It's called Pirates of the Limabean.
Um, can we get your autograph?
- We love iCarly. - New web show.
- There you go. - There you go.
Wow. I just signed an autograph.
Get used to it. iCarly's a great show.
- Yeah. - I don't know if I'm gonna like that.
- So, you guys wanna dance? - Yes.
